scope: Whole archived guide and pinned HTML; source interpretation, not human/server verification

1.original_instruction: In the Midgard Expedition Camp , speak to Bazett Teablack ( mid_camp 283, 198); he requests your help investigating the local tribes.
1.short_ru: Предложите помощь Bazett Teablack в mid_camp 283, 198.
1.short_en: Offer help to Bazett Teablack at mid_camp 283, 198.
1.full_ru: В Midgard Expedition Camp поговорите с Bazett Teablack (mid_camp 283, 198). Он попросит помочь с изучением местных племён.
1.full_en: In the Midgard Expedition Camp , speak to Bazett Teablack ( mid_camp 283, 198); he requests your help investigating the local tribes.

2.original_instruction: Speak to him again, and he will ask you to go search for giants on the Manuk Fields.
2.short_ru: Снова поговорите с Bazett Teablack о поиске великанов в Manuk Fields.
2.short_en: Talk to Bazett Teablack again about finding giants in Manuk Fields.
2.full_ru: Поговорите с ним ещё раз: он попросит отправиться на поиски великанов в Manuk Fields.
2.full_en: Speak to him again, and he will ask you to go search for giants on the Manuk Fields.

npcs.evidence: In the Midgard Expedition Camp , speak to Bazett Teablack ( mid_camp 283, 198); he requests your help investigating the local tribes.

3.original_instruction: Speak to the Worker in Manuk ( manuk 194, 135). He asks you to get him 30 Horn of Hillslion so that he can make a replacement screw for a building.
3.short_ru: Поговорите с Worker в manuk 194, 135 и соберите 30 Horn of Hillslion.
3.short_en: Talk to Worker at manuk 194, 135 and collect 30 Horn of Hillslion.
3.full_ru: Поговорите с Worker в Manuk (manuk 194, 135). Он попросит 30 Horn of Hillslion, чтобы сделать запасной винт для здания.
3.full_en: Speak to the Worker in Manuk ( manuk 194, 135). He asks you to get him 30 Horn of Hillslion so that he can make a replacement screw for a building.

4.short_ru: Передайте 30 Horn of Hillslion Worker в Manuk.
4.short_en: Deliver 30 Horn of Hillslion to Worker in Manuk.

npcs.evidence: Speak to the Worker in Manuk ( manuk 194, 135). He asks you to get him 30 Horn of Hillslion so that he can make a replacement screw for a building.

locations.evidence: Speak to the Worker in Manuk ( manuk 194, 135). He asks you to get him 30 Horn of Hillslion so that he can make a replacement screw for a building.

5.original_instruction: Return to Bazett, he thanks you and tells you to go rest. Receive 1 Manuk Coin .
5.short_ru: Вернитесь к Bazett Teablack и получите 1 Manuk Coin.
5.short_en: Return to Bazett Teablack and receive 1 Manuk Coin.
5.full_ru: Вернитесь к Bazett. Он поблагодарит вас и предложит отдохнуть. Получите 1 Manuk Coin.
5.full_en: Return to Bazett, he thanks you and tells you to go rest. Receive 1 Manuk Coin .

reviews.detail: This page does not state repeatability or a cooldown. Rest wording is not a timed gate. No mandatory giant kills, crafted screw item or EXP reward is invented.

requirements.condition: Summary of the single set delivered to Worker, not a second set.
